No qty facet - any nonzero amount of life gained fires it (CR 119.9: 'if a player gains 0 life ... these abilities won't trigger'). kind=STATE follows the registered life stem (state=fold(events)); the trigger fires on the life-change folded into that state. Live label trigger:life:gain:controlled.

notes: THE WITNESSED EDGE: a life emit satisfies a life subscription. Direction-feeds: S1.direction=gain feeds P1.direction=gain (policy:life-direction-match); a gain emit would NEVER feed a loss-trigger - the load-bearing direction match (CR 119.9: a loss event is not a life-gain event, so a gain-trigger won't fire on it).

GREEN tiering: recipient=you (S1) Subsumes recipient=you (P1) EXACTLY - You<->You, control lattice you=you (the subscription-subject Subsumes->GREEN branch, reuse policy:subscription:subject-subsumes-green, confirmed). No self-watch guard applies: 'whenever you gain life' watches a PLAYER-scoped life-change event (CR 119.9 'a source causes a player to gain life'), not an object-identity, so ANY source causing you to gain life fires it - fully observable, no Overlaps floor. The GREEN contrast to captain-rex's self-watch AMBER.
the +1/+1 counter payoff (P1's effect) is not modeled - not part of the witnessed edge; this is the smallest honest pairwise (emit -> subscription, no cycle closed).

match_policy.subject: facet-feeds
match_policy.lattice: gain |= gain ; loss |= loss (a life subscription is fed only by a same-direction life event; a gain never feeds a loss-trigger, nor a loss a gain-trigger)
match_policy.desc: a life STATE emit feeds a life subscription (a 'whenever [a player] gains/loses life' trigger, CR 119.9) only when the direction facets match: a gain-direction emit feeds a gain-direction trigger, a loss feeds a loss; a gain NEVER feeds a loss-trigger and vice versa - a loss event is not a life-gain event, so a gain-trigger won't fire on it (CR 119.9). Directional on the direction axis - the life analogue of policy:damage-manner-feeds (combat axis). Implements the engine's LifeFlowFeasible direction-match gate (CR 119). The player-scope overlap (who gains vs whom the trigger watches) is the operator's job via the recipient Subjects; this rule gates only the direction.

assertions.because: direction gain=gain feasible (policy:life-direction-match) AND recipient=you Subsumes recipient=you (You<->You, control lattice you=you) with NO self-watch guard - the life-gain trigger watches a player-scoped event (CR 119.9), fully observable -> GREEN

the emit->subscription match is certified by policy:life-direction-match (the direction-feeds relation), not a structural subsumption; the GREEN tiering reuses policy:subscription:subject-subsumes-green (recipient you Subsumes you)

S1.direction=gain feeds P1.direction=gain, but a life:loss emit (e.g. Blood Artist's 'target player loses 1 life') NEVER feeds a gain-direction trigger - a loss event is not a life-gain event (policy:life-direction-match, CR 119.9). Direction-match is load-bearing.
